exercises.problem_summary_vi: Thiết kế bể bùn hoạt tính khuấy trộn hoàn toàn (Complete-Mix Activated Sludge - CMAS) chỉ khử BOD cho lưu lượng Q = 22,700 m3/ngày ở nhiệt độ 12oC, SRT = 5 ngày, MLSS = 3000 g/m3, chiều sâu nước 4.9 m, chiều sâu đặt đĩa phân phối khí 4.4 m, DO = 2 g/m3, cao trình 500 m, alpha = 0.50, beta = 0.95, F = 0.90.

Adjust kinetic coefficients to T = 12oC: mu_m,12 = 6.0 x 1.07^(12 - 20) = 3.5 g/g.d; bH,12 = 0.12 x 1.04^(12 - 20) = 0.088 g/g.d; Ks,12 = 8.0 g/m3
Select oxygen transfer efficiency E = 30% (typical range 25 - 40% from Slide 11) and return sludge concentration XR = 8000 g/m3

Px,bio = [Q x YH x (S0 - S)] / (1 + bH x SRT) + [fd x bH x Q x YH x (S0 - S) x SRT] / (1 + bH x SRT)
PX,VSS = Px,bio + Q x nbVSS; PX,TSS = (Px,bio / 0.85) + Q x nbVSS + Q x (TSSo - VSSo)
Mass of MLVSS = PX,VSS x SRT; Mass of MLSS = PX,TSS x SRT; V = (Mass of MLSS) / XTSS
Ro = Q x (S0 - S) - 1.42 x Px,bio
SOTR = (OTRf / (alpha x F)) x [C_inf,20 / (tau x beta x Omega x C_inf,20 - C)] x (1 / 1.024^(T - 20))
Air flowrate (m3/min) = SOTR / (E x 60 min/h x 0.27 kg O2/m3 air)

3. Biomass and sludge production:

exercises.problem_summary_vi: Thiết kế bể phản ứng sinh học màng (Membrane Bioreactor - MBR) với cùng thông số đầu vào và sinh khối từ Ví dụ 2 (SRT = 21 ngày, Px,bio = 1050.4 kg/ngày, PX,VSS = 1504.4 kg/ngày, PX,TSS = 1916.8 kg/ngày, tổng MLVSS = 31,592 kg, tổng MLSS = 40,253 kg, tỷ lệ MLVSS/MLSS = 0.785), biết tỷ số tuần hoàn R = 6, MLSS bể màng Xm = 12,000 g/m3, thông lượng màng 16 L/m2.h và tỷ lệ thể tích bể màng trên diện tích màng là 0.025 m3/m2.
design_parameters_selected: Given from Slide 43: SRT = 21 d, R = 6, Xm = 12,000 g/m3, Membrane flux = 16 L/m2.h = 0.384 m3/m2.d, Vm / Am = 0.025 m3/m2
Check MBR parameter ranges against Slide 40: R = 6 (in range 4 - 6), Xm = 12,000 g/m3 (in range 8,000 - 12,000 g/m3), Vm / Am = 0.025 m3/m2 (in range 0.015 - 0.05 m3/m2)
governing_equations: R x Xm = (1 + R) x XA ➔ XA = [R / (1 + R)] x Xm
Am = Q / Flux; Vm = (Vm / Am) x Am
Mass of MLSS = XA x VA + Xm x Vm
SRT = (XA x VA + Xm x Vm) / (Qw x Xm) ➔ Qw = PX,TSS / Xm
worked_solution_steps: Solution:
1. Calculate MLSS concentration in the aerobic zone (Slide 39 mass balance):
2. Calculate required membrane surface area and membrane tank volume (Slide 40 & 43):
Membrane flux = 16 L/m2.h = 16 x 24 x 10^-3 m3/m2.d = 0.384 m3/m2.d
Membrane surface area: Am = Q / Flux = (22,700 m3/d) / (0.384 m3/m2.d) = 59,115 m2
Membrane tank volume: Vm = 0.025 m3/m2 x 59,115 m2 = 1,478 m3
3. Calculate mass of solids in membrane tank and required aerobic tank volume:
Mass of MLSS in membrane tank = Vm x Xm = 1,478 m3 x 12,000 g/m3 x 10^-3 kg/g = 17,736 kg
Mass of MLSS in aerobic tank = Total MLSS - Mass in membrane tank = 40,253 kg - 17,736 kg = 22,517 kg
Aerobic tank volume: VA = (22,517 kg x 10^3 g/kg) / (10,286 g/m3) = 2,189 m3
Total MBR volume: V_total = VA + Vm = 2,189 m3 + 1,478 m3 = 3,667 m3
Overall hydraulic retention time: HRT = (3,667 m3 / 22,700 m3/d) x 24 h/d = 3.88 h
4. Calculate waste sludge flowrate Qw and F/M ratio:
Overall F/M = (22,700 m3/d x 140 g/m3 x 10^-3) / (31,592 kg MLVSS) = 0.10 kg BOD/kg MLVSS.d
Organic loading rate = (22,700 m3/d x 0.140 kg/m3) / 3,667 m3 = 0.87 kg BOD/m3.d
verification_checks: Check R = 6 in typical range 4 - 6 from Slide 40 (satisfy)
Check Xm = 12,000 g/m3 in typical range 8,000 - 12,000 g/m3 from Slide 40 (satisfy)
Check Vm/Am = 0.025 m3/m2 in typical range 0.015 - 0.05 m3/m2 from Slide 40 (satisfy)
Check total MLSS mass = (10,286 x 2,189 + 12,000 x 1,478) / 1000 = 40,253 kg (satisfy)

exercises.problem_summary_vi: Thiết kế bể phản ứng theo mẻ kế tiếp (Sequencing Batch Reactor - SBR) xử lý lưu lượng Q = 7,570 m3/ngày ở T = 12oC, nồng độ MLSS khi đầy bể XTSS = 3,500 g/m3, SVI = 150 mL/g, dùng 2 bể, chiều sâu mực nước khi đầy H = 6 m, chiều sâu xả nước (decant depth) bằng 20% chiều sâu bể, yêu cầu NH4-N đầu ra Ne = 1.0 g/m3.
design_parameters_selected: Select 2 SBR tanks (N = 2), full liquid depth H = 6.0 m, decant depth = 20% of H = 1.2 m ➔ Fill fraction VF / VT = 0.20
Select 6-h cycle from Slide 49: Total cycle tc = 6.0 h (4 cycles/tank.d ➔ 8 cycles/d total for 2 tanks) with Fill tF = 3.0 h, React tR = 2.0 h, Settle tS = 0.5 h, Decant tD = 0.5 h

Trial aeration time = 2.0 h (React only) ➔ Check nitrification time required = 2.85 h (not satisfy) ➔ Reselect aeration during last 1.0 h of Fill + 2.0 h of React = 3.0 h total aeration per cycle (satisfy)
governing_equations: F(VT) = (MLSS, mg/L) x (SVI, mL/g) / 10^6; Check VF / VT <= 1 - 1.2 x F(VT)
VF = Q / N_cycles_total; VT = VF / (VF / VT); HRT = (N_tanks x VT) / Q
Mass of MLSS = N_tanks x VT x XTSS = PX,TSS x SRT
K_NH4 x ln(N0 / Nt) + (N0 - Nt) = (mu_nm x Xn / Yn) x [DO / (Ko + DO)] x t
worked_solution_steps: Solution:
1. Influent wastewater characterization (from Slide 51 table):
bCOD = 1.6 x BOD = 1.6 x 220 g/m3 = 352 g/m3
2. Check fill fraction and determine SBR tank volume (Slide 49 & 50):
Settled solids volume fraction: F(VT) = (3,500 mg/L x 150 mL/g) / 10^6 = 0.525
With 20% clear liquid buffer above sludge blanket: VS / VT = 1.2 x 0.525 = 0.63 ➔ Max fill fraction = 1 - 0.63 = 0.37 > 0.20 (satisfy)
Select 6-h cycle (3.0-h fill, 2.0-h react, 0.5-h settle, 0.5-h decant) ➔ 4 cycles/tank.d ➔ 8 cycles/d for 2 tanks
Fill volume per cycle: VF = (7,570 m3/d) / (8 cycles/d) = 946.25 m3/cycle
Volume per tank: VT = VF / 0.20 = 946.25 / 0.20 = 4,731.25 m3 ➔ Total volume of 2 tanks: V_total = 2 x 4,731.25 = 9,462.5 m3
Check HRT = (9,462.5 m3 / 7,570 m3/d) x 24 h/d = 30.0 h (satisfy 18 - 30 h from Slide 49)
Solution (continue):
3. Determine operating SRT at MLSS = 3,500 g/m3:
Total MLSS mass in 2 tanks = 9,462.5 m3 x 3,500 g/m3 x 10^-3 kg/g = 33,119 kg
Solve Mass_TSS = PX,TSS x SRT = 33,119 kg at T = 12oC (bH = 0.088 d^-1, bn = 0.135 d^-1): obtain SRT = 26.5 d (satisfy 15 - 30 d from Slide 65)
4. Check nitrification reaction time (Slide 48 equation):
Oxidizable nitrogen concentration: NOx = TKNo - Ne - 0.12 x Px,bio / Q = 35.0 - 1.0 - (0.12 x 492,300 / 7,570) = 26.2 g/m3 (24,792 g/cycle)
Initial NH4-N concentration if no aeration during fill: N0 = (3,785 m3 x 1.0 g/m3 + 946.25 m3 x 26.2 g/m3) / 4,731.25 m3 = 6.04 g/m3
Nitrifier concentration in tank: Xn = [Q x Yn x NOx x SRT / (1 + bn x SRT)] / V_total = 18.2 g/m3
Check trial aeration time = 2.0 h < 2.85 h (not satisfy) ➔ Reselect aeration during last 1.0 h of Fill + 2.0 h of React = 3.0 h > 2.85 h (satisfy)
5. Decant rate, oxygen demand and loading checks:
Decant pumping rate (tD = 0.5 h = 30 min): q_decant = 946.25 m3 / 30 min = 31.5 m3/min
Check F/M = (7,570 x 0.220) / (9,462.5 x 2,832 x 10^-3) = 0.062 kg BOD/kg MLVSS.d (satisfy 0.04 - 0.1 from Slide 65); L_org = 0.18 kg BOD/m3.d (satisfy 0.1 - 0.3 from Slide 65)
verification_checks: Check fill fraction VF/VT = 0.20 < max 0.37 (satisfy)
Check HRT = 30.0 h in range 18 - 30 h from Slide 49 (satisfy)
Check SRT = 26.5 d in range 15 - 30 d from Slide 65 (satisfy)
Check trial aeration time = 2.0 h < 2.85 h (not satisfy) ➔ Reselect aeration time = 3.0 h (1.0 h aerated fill + 2.0 h react) > 2.85 h (satisfy)
Check F/M = 0.062 kg BOD/kg MLVSS.d in range 0.04 - 0.1 and L_org = 0.18 kg BOD/m3.d in range 0.1 - 0.3 (satisfy)

final_answers.Cycle_schedule: 6.0 h cycle (2.0 h mixed fill, 1.0 h aerated fill, 2.0 h react, 0.5 h settle, 0.5 h decant)

exercises.problem_summary_vi: Thiết kế bể thiếu khí đầu nguồn (Preanoxic tank) dùng bể lắng thứ cấp với cùng thông số đầu vào như Ví dụ 2 Chương 6 (Q = 22,700 m3/ngày, T = 12oC, SRT = 21 ngày, NOx = 29.0 g/m3, VA = 13,418 m3, XTSS = 3,000 g/m3) để đạt nồng độ NO3-N đầu ra Ne = 6.0 g/m3.
design_parameters_selected: Select return activated sludge ratio R = 0.60 (from secondary clarifier underflow XR = 8,000 g/m3)
From Chapter 5.2 Slide 25 SDNR coefficients for rbCOD / bCOD = 80 / 224 = 35.7%: interpolate between 30% (b0 = 0.235, b1 = 0.141) and 40% (b0 = 0.242, b1 = 0.152) ➔ b0 = 0.239, b1 = 0.147
Temperature correction factor for SDNR from Chapter 5.2 Slide 26: theta = 1.026
Trial anoxic detention time tau_nox = 1.8 h (not satisfy) ➔ Reselect tau_nox = 2.2 h (V_nox = 2,081 m3) (satisfy); mixer power = 8 W/m3 (Chapter 5.2 Slide 22)
governing_equations: IR = (NOx / Ne) - 1 - R (Slide 5 of Chapter 7)
NOx_feed = Q x (IR + R) x Ne
Xb = [Q x SRT x YH x (S0 - S)] / [VA x (1 + bH x SRT)] (Slide 23 of Chapter 5.2)
F/Mb = (Q x BOD) / (V_nox x Xb) (Slide 24 of Chapter 5.2)
SDNR20 = b0 + b1 x ln(F/Mb); SDNR_adj = SDNR20 - 0.029 x ln(F/Mb) - 0.012 (for IR = 3 - 4, Slide 25 & 26 of Chapter 5.2)
SDNR_T = SDNR_adj x 1.026^(T - 20); NOr = V_nox x Xb x SDNR_T
worked_solution_steps: Solution:
1. Determine internal recycle ratio IR and nitrate mass fed to anoxic zone (Slide 5):
From Example 2 Chapter 6: Q = 22,700 m3/d, NOx = 29.0 g/m3 (28.95 g/m3), required Ne = 6.0 g/m3, select R = 0.60
Nitrate fed to anoxic tank: NOx_feed = Q x (IR + R) x Ne = 22,700 m3/d x (3.23 + 0.60) x 6.0 g/m3 x 10^-3 kg/g = 521.6 kg NO3-N/d
2. Calculate active heterotrophic biomass concentration Xb (Chapter 5.2 Slide 23):
3. Size anoxic tank and check nitrate removal capacity NOr:
Percent rbCOD / bCOD = 80 / 224 = 35.7% ➔ b0 = 0.239, b1 = 0.147 (Chapter 5.2 Slide 25)
Trial 1: Select anoxic detention time tau_nox = 1.8 h ➔ V_nox = 22,700 x (1.8 / 24) = 1,702 m3
Solution (continue):
Trial 2: Reselect anoxic detention time tau_nox = 2.2 h ➔ V_nox = 22,700 x (2.2 / 24) = 2,081 m3
Check nitrate removal capacity: NOr = 2,081 m3 x 1,256 g/m3 x 0.204 g/g.d x 10^-3 = 532.3 kg/d >= 521.6 kg/d (satisfy)
4. Calculate oxygen credit, alkalinity recovery, and anoxic mixer power:
Alkalinity recovery = 3.57 g CaCO3/g NO3-N x (29.0 - 6.0) g/m3 = 82.1 g/m3 as CaCO3 ➔ Net Alk_added = 80 - (140 - 206.7 + 82.1) = 64.6 g/m3 as CaCO3
Anoxic mixing power required (8 W/m3 from Chapter 5.2 Slide 22) = 8 W/m3 x 2,081 m3 x 10^-3 = 16.6 kW
verification_checks: Check trial tau_nox = 1.8 h: NOr = 476.7 kg/d < NOx_feed = 521.6 kg/d (not satisfy)
Reselect tau_nox = 2.2 h (V_nox = 2,081 m3): Check NOr = 532.3 kg/d >= 521.6 kg/d (satisfy)
Check SDNR20,adj = 0.250 g/g.d in typical preanoxic range 0.04 - 0.25 g/g.d from Chapter 5.2 Slide 23 (satisfy)

exercises.problem_summary_vi: Thiết kế bể thiếu khí đầu nguồn kết hợp tách màng (Preanoxic MBR) với cùng thông số đầu vào như Ví dụ 3 Chương 6 (Q = 22,700 m3/ngày, SRT = 21 ngày, R = 6, Xm = 12,000 g/m3, XA = 10,286 g/m3, không dùng tuần hoàn nội bộ IR = 0).
design_parameters_selected: Given from Slide 12 of Chapter 7 and Example 3 of Chapter 6: IR = 0, RAS ratio from membrane tank to preanoxic tank R = 6, XA = 10,286 g/m3
Trial anoxic volume V_nox = 550 m3 (not satisfy) ➔ Reselect V_nox = 700 m3 (tau_nox = 0.74 h) (satisfy)
Select anoxic mixer specific power = 8 W/m3 (Chapter 5.2 Slide 22)
governing_equations: NOx = (1 + IR + R) x Ne ➔ Ne = NOx / (1 + R) (for IR = 0)
NOx_feed = Q x R x Ne
Xb,MBR = (Mass of active heterotrophs / Total MLSS mass) x XA
F/Mb = (Q x BOD) / (V_nox x Xb,MBR); NOr = V_nox x Xb,MBR x SDNR_T
worked_solution_steps: Solution:
1. Determine effluent nitrate concentration Ne and nitrate fed to anoxic zone (with IR = 0, R = 6):
From Slide 5 & 12: NOx = (1 + IR + R) x Ne = (1 + 0 + 6) x Ne = 7 x Ne
With NOx = 29.0 g/m3 (from Example 2 & 3 Chapter 6): Ne = 29.0 / 7 = 4.14 g/m3 <= 6.0 g/m3 (satisfy)
Nitrate fed to anoxic zone via RAS (R = 6): NOx_feed = Q x R x Ne = 22,700 m3/d x 6 x 4.14 g/m3 x 10^-3 = 564.3 kg NO3-N/d
2. Calculate active heterotrophic biomass concentration Xb,MBR in anoxic zone:
From Example 2 & 3 Chapter 6: Active heterotrophic mass = 802.35 kg/d x 21 d = 16,849 kg; Total MLSS mass = 40,253 kg
Active fraction of MLSS = 16,849 / 40,253 = 0.4186
Since MLSS in anoxic and aerobic zones is XA = [6 / (1 + 6)] x 12,000 = 10,286 g/m3: Xb,MBR = 0.4186 x 10,286 g/m3 = 4,305 g/m3
Solution (continue):
3. Size anoxic tank and check nitrate removal capacity NOr:
Trial 1: Select V_nox = 550 m3 (tau_nox = 0.58 h) ➔ F/Mb = (22,700 x 140) / (550 x 4,305) = 1.34 g BOD/g biomass.d
SDNR20 = 0.239 + 0.147 x ln(1.34) = 0.282 g/g.d ➔ Adjusted for high recycle (R = 6): SDNR20,adj = 0.282 - 0.029 x ln(1.34) - 0.012 = 0.262 g/g.d
Trial 2: Reselect V_nox = 700 m3 (tau_nox = 0.74 h = 44.4 min) ➔ F/Mb = (22,700 x 140) / (700 x 4,305) = 1.05 g BOD/g biomass.d
Check nitrate removal capacity: NOr = 700 m3 x 4,305 g/m3 x 0.190 g/g.d x 10^-3 = 572.5 kg/d >= 564.3 kg/d (satisfy)
4. Summary of Preanoxic MBR volumes and mixing power:

exercises.problem_summary_vi: Thiết kế và kiểm tra quá trình khử nitrat trong bể SBR (Denitrification process in SBR) với cùng thông số đầu vào như Ví dụ 4 Chương 6 (Q = 7,570 m3/ngày, T = 12oC, 2 bể SBR, VT = 4,731.25 m3/bể, VF = 946.25 m3/mẻ, SRT = 26.5 ngày, NOx = 26.2 g/m3).
design_parameters_selected: From Example 4 Chapter 6: 2 SBR tanks, 6-h cycle (4 cycles/tank.d = 8 cycles/d total) with 2.0-h mixed anoxic fill, 1.0-h aerated fill, 2.0-h aerobic react, 0.5-h settle, 0.5-h decant
Fill fraction VF / VT = 0.20 (VF = 946.25 m3, remaining settled volume after decant VS = VT - VF = 3,785 m3)
For F/Mb <= 0.5: use linear SDNR equation from Chapter 5.2 Slide 25: SDNR20 = 0.24 x (F/Mb) and theta = 1.026
governing_equations: NOx_cycle = VF x NOx; Ne,NO3 = NOx_cycle / VT (when all NO3-N in VS is denitrified during anoxic fill)
NO3-N_rem_in_VS = VS x Ne,NO3
Mass_Xb,1tank = [Q x SRT x YH x (S0 - S) / (1 + bH x SRT)] / 2
F/Mb = (Q_fill x BOD) / Mass_Xb,1tank; SDNR20 = 0.24 x (F/Mb) (for F/Mb <= 0.5)
NOr_cycle = Mass_Xb,1tank x SDNR_T x (t_anoxic_fill / 24 h/d)
worked_solution_steps: Solution:
1. Calculate nitrate produced per cycle and nitrate remaining after decant (Slide 19 & 20):
From Example 4 Chapter 6: VF = 946.25 m3/cycle, VT = 4,731.25 m3/tank, VS = VT - VF = 3,785 m3/tank, NOx = 26.2 g/m3
Nitrate produced per cycle in 1 tank: NOx_cycle = VF x NOx = 946.25 m3 x 26.2 g/m3 = 24,792 g NO3-N/cycle
Assuming complete removal of pre-fill nitrate during the 2.0-h anoxic fill, nitrate concentration at end of react/decant is:
Nitrate mass remaining in tank volume VS = 3,785 m3 after decant (to be removed during next 2.0-h anoxic fill):
NO3-N_to_remove = VS x Ne,NO3 = 3,785 m3 x 5.24 g/m3 = 19,833 g NO3-N/cycle (19.83 kg/cycle)
Solution (continue):
2. Calculate active heterotrophic biomass and F/Mb during the 2.0-h anoxic fill:
Total active heterotrophic biomass in 2 tanks at SRT = 26.5 d: Mass_Xb,total = [7,570 x 26.5 x 0.45 x (352 - 0.3)] / [1 + (0.088 x 26.5)] x 10^-3 = 9,528.4 kg
Active biomass in 1 SBR tank: Mass_Xb,1tank = 9,528.4 / 2 = 4,764.2 kg
Flowrate into 1 tank during 3.0-h fill: Q_fill = 946.25 m3 / 3.0 h = 315.42 m3/h = 7,570 m3/d
Food-to-microorganism ratio during anoxic fill: F/Mb = (7,570 m3/d x 220 g/m3 x 10^-3) / (4,764.2 kg) = 0.35 g BOD/g biomass.d
3. Calculate SDNR and verify nitrate removal capacity during 2.0-h anoxic fill:
Since F/Mb = 0.35 <= 0.5 (Chapter 5.2 Slide 25): SDNR20 = 0.24 x (F/Mb) = 0.24 x 0.35 = 0.084 g NO3-N/g biomass.d
Nitrate removal capacity during 2.0-h mixed anoxic fill: NOr_cycle = 4,764.2 kg x 1,000 g/kg x 0.068 g/g.d x (2.0 h / 24 h/d) = 27,125 g NO3-N/cycle
Check denitrification capacity: NOr_cycle = 27,125 g/cycle >= 19,833 g/cycle (satisfy)
4. Oxygen credit and alkalinity recovery in SBR:
Total NO3-N reduced per day (8 cycles/d) = 8 x 19.833 kg/cycle = 158.7 kg NO3-N/d
Alkalinity recovered = 3.57 x (26.2 - 5.24) = 74.8 g/m3 as CaCO3
